notes: Same MILP class as garuda_tierA_time_limit_highs but the binding numeric is the optimality tolerance: mipgap 1e-6 forces the branch-and-bound to close a gap that is irrelevant at planning accuracy, so the 300 s budget expires with an incumbent and a large remaining gap. Fix = loosen mipgap back to ~0.01 (Tier A); raising time_limit alone would need hours.
